title: Monte Cristo
subtitle: A ham and cheese sandwich dipped in egg and fried until golden
excerpt: Ham and cheese between white bread, dipped in beaten egg and fried to a crisp golden crust. Dust with icing sugar and serve with jam on the side.
sourceNotes: Classic American diner sandwich, common across US diners since the 1950s.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble the sandwiches up to one hour ahead. Dip and fry just before serving.

content.text: This is a fried sandwich that sits between a croque monsieur and French toast. The egg batter puffs and crisps around the bread in the pan. Keep the heat medium so the cheese melts before the outside burns.
Spread mustard on two slices of bread if using. Lay the ham on top, then the cheese. Press the remaining slices on top to close.
Beat the eggs and milk together in a wide shallow bowl. Season with a pinch of salt.
Dip each sandwich in the egg mixture. Let it soak for 10 seconds per side so the bread absorbs the batter.
Melt the butter in the frying pan over a medium heat until it foams.
Lay the sandwiches in the pan. Cook for 3 to 4 minutes until deep gold on the base.
Flip carefully and cook for another 3 minutes. The cheese should be fully melted.
Lift onto plates. Dust with icing sugar and serve with jam alongside.

items.symptom: The outside browns before the cheese melts.
items.fix: Lower to medium-low and cover the pan with a lid for the last 2 minutes.

items.symptom: The egg batter slides off the bread.
items.cause: The bread was not soaked long enough.
items.fix: Hold each side in the egg mix for a full 10 seconds and press gently so it absorbs.

items.symptom: The filling falls out when flipping.
items.cause: The sandwich was overfilled or the layers shifted.
items.fix: Press the sandwich together firmly before dipping and flip with a wide spatula in one smooth motion.
